title: Implementation of a New Algorithm for HRR Gene Mutation Testing in Patients With mPC Through Liquid Biopsy Integration
official: Implementation of a New Algorithm for HRR Gene Mutation Testing in Patients With mPC
summary: Implementation of a new algorithm for HRR gene mutation testing in patients with mPC through liquid biopsy integration
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with metastatic prostate cancer whose tumor tissue is unavailable or inadequate for molecular testing. • Written informed consent must be signed and dated by the patient and the investigator prior to inclusion.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to provide written informed consent
